name: Deathguard Simmer
summary: At Deathknell’s edge, Deathguard Simmer sizes up newly risen Forsaken. He sends them west to raid a human pumpkin farm patrolled by the Scarlet Crusade, gathering reagents Brill’s apothecaries need.

sections.title: Guardian Outside Deathknell
sections.body: Deathguard Simmer guards the ground just outside Deathknell, where the Forsaken hold the line between their haven and Tirisfal Glades. Living humans roam the region, including the fanatical Scarlet Crusade, who see all undead as abominations to purge with fire and blade. Simmer tests newly risen Forsaken by sending them west to Solliden Farmstead. Scarlet Crusade soldiers patrol from a nearby tower. The recruits must steal ten pumpkins and carry them to Apothecary Johaan in Brill.

faq.answer: Deathguard Simmer is a Forsaken sentry just outside Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. He tests newly risen Forsaken by sending them to steal pumpkins from a human farm patrolled by the Scarlet Crusade.
Deathguard Simmer stands just outside Deathknell in southwestern Tirisfal Glades, beside the road newly risen Forsaken take from the crypts.

faq.q: What threats does Deathguard Simmer fight?
faq.answer: Deathguard Simmer despises the living humans who still farm Tirisfal and the Scarlet Crusade that patrols near them. He sends newly risen Forsaken to raid Solliden Farmstead for pumpkins, teaching those humans a lesson and supplying Brill’s apothecaries.

angles.text: As an undead, you first face the Scarlet Crusade through Simmer’s missions. He sends you beyond Deathknell’s crypts to defend Lordaeron.
